items.mainDefect: The hard-coded 10MB client limit lets attachments exceeding the configured attachment limit upload before server rejection.

secondary.defect: The client validation and 413 error messages display 10MB instead of the configured limit.

items.mainDefect: Attachments exceeding the configured attachment limit pass the hard-coded 10MB client check.

secondary.defect: The translated file-too-large message displays 10240KB instead of the enforced attachment limit.

items.mainDefect: The hard-coded 10MB client cap rejects valid attachments when the configured attachment limit exceeds 10MB.

secondary.defect: When the configured attachment limit is below 10MB, oversized attachments pass client validation and upload fully before server rejection.
